description: "Use when writing or editing Markdown documentation in this repository. Covers reader-friendly tone, clear wording, and punctuation."
name: "Documentation Writing Style"
applyTo: "**/*.md"

# Documentation Writing Style

- Write for the reader. Use a warm, direct tone and speak to them as "you" when it makes the instructions clearer.
- Prefer plain, familiar words and short sentences. Explain technical terms when readers need them to complete a task.
- Use active voice and specific actions. Organize setup guidance as steps when readers need to do things in order.
- Do not use em dashes or en dashes as punctuation. Use a period, comma, colon, or parentheses instead. Hyphenated terms such as "read-only" are fine.
- Keep internal implementation details out of reader-facing instructions. Put useful technical references in a clearly labeled source section.
- Do not guess at provider account setup or credential issuance. Link to verified instructions or tell readers whom to contact.
